enchantments.tooltip: Taint of Chaos: Lawful aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
Rune Arm Charge Rate: 30%: This Rune Arm has a 30% Enhancement bonus to its Charge Rate.
Impulse +141: Passive: +141 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Natural Armor +13: Passive: +13 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +26 (Insight bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Insightful Evocation Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
